name: Leicestershire Partnership NHS Trust — autism and communication support
description: NHS autism information describing different communication forms and support approaches, including written, visual and AAC communication and neuroaffirmative communication support.
intended_use: Use as a practical communication-support route when spoken conversation is difficult or a family needs to consider alternative ways to communicate.
audience_or_context: Autistic people, families, carers and professionals; local service references may be Leicestershire-specific while the communication information is broader.
limitations: Local service access information is not a national entitlement.
The page is autism-specific and should not be used to infer diagnosis from communication style.
conflicts_of_interest: Published by an NHS trust; ND Oracle records it as an information route, not proof that one communication approach suits every person.
